title: A Standardized Framework for Machine Learning in Power System Protection
abstract: arXiv:2608.20181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Studies of machine-learning-based power-system protection increasingly report near-perfect scores, yet the meaning of those scores depends strongly on the evaluation setting. Protection task, physical scope, measurements, timing, targets, preprocessing, and validation often vary jointly and remain incompletely specified. This paper proposes a standardization-oriented framework that treats evaluation design as part of the scientific contribution. It defines seven required study dimensions: protection objective, physical scope, observability, timing and decision windows, targets and sample validity, validation protocol, and evaluation outputs. The framework is instantiated in a bounded case study on the public PROTECT-90 electromagnetic-transient benchmark, comprising 9022 simulated episodes from a 90 kV double-line topology, for onset-conditioned fault classification and localization. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20181v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于机器学习的电力系统保护研究越来越多地报告近乎完美的分数，然而这些分数的意义在很大程度上取决于评估设置。保护任务、物理范围、测量、时序、目标、预处理和验证往往共同变化且说明不完整。本文提出了一个面向标准化的框架，将评估设计视为科学贡献的一部分。该框架定义了七个必需的研究维度：保护目标、物理范围、可观测性、时序与决策窗口、目标与样本有效性、验证协议以及评估输出。该框架在一个有界的案例研究中得到实例化，基于公共PROTECT-90电磁暂态基准，包含来自90 kV双线拓扑的9022个模拟事件，用于起始条件故障分类和定位。在集中式感知下，模拟元数据对齐...
tldr: 本文提出了一个电力系统保护机器学习评估的标准化框架，定义了七个关键研究维度，并在PROTECT-90基准上进行了实例验证，旨在提高研究结果的可比性和科学性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a standardization framework for machine learning evaluation in power system protection, defining seven key study dimensions and instantiating it on the PROTECT-90 benchmark to enhance comparability and scientific rigor.
